list.text: A paper calendar by the door. Seven days are crossed out in Sachi’s hand, and the last is circled: LANTERN NIGHT. Seven nights left.
The wall calendar. Night 2 is crossed out. Six nights to Lantern Night, circled in red. Mio’s wick drawer is half open beneath it.

lines: Ashiro Village, on the eve of the Lantern Festival.
Every year the villagers light one lantern for each spirit who has walked beside them.
This year, the Shrine Bell has not rung… and the lanterns will not light.

list.name: Granny Sachi
list.text: Mio, child. Come here by the lamp. Your hands are cold.

list.name: Mio
list.text: Granny, the festival starts at dusk, and the Bell hasn’t rung. Nothing is lit. Is it… because of me?

list.name: Granny Sachi
list.text: Never you. Listen: your grandfather carried this before me, and his mother before him.
Granny Sachi places an old paper Lantern in Mio’s hands. It is warm, as if someone had just set it down.

list.name: Granny Sachi
list.text: It shows what the night hides. Press the little wick, and the world will tip toward the Far Shore, where spirits walk. Pull it back, and you’re home again.

list.name: Granny Sachi
list.text: Light the Lantern Post in the village square. Then go see Elder Matsu. Take care of your light, child. It’s the only thing that follows you across.
Move: Arrows/WASD · Talk/OK: Z/Enter · Menu: X/Esc · Dash: hold Shift · Shift realms: Q/Tab

then.name: Granny Sachi
then.text: Ah, you have begun to meet them properly. Here, child: my old ledger. Spirits you meet write themselves in it, and the bonds you keep.
Keeper’s Ledger: Menu now shows Bonds (equip, give Offerings) and the Bestiary. Check Key Items for everything else you carry.

then.name: Granny Sachi
then.text: You faced the Warden and came back whole. Good. Listen, child — not every spirit on the Far Shore wants to fight.

then.name: Granny Sachi
then.text: Parley lets you talk: Soothe, Hum, Remember, Offer something they love. Fill their Mood and they turn Calm. Then you may Send them onward — or Invite one to walk beside you as a Bond.
Send unlocks at Lv 3 · Invite at Lv 4. Calm spirits drop Wish Scraps; hollowed ones leave Name Fragments.

then.name: Granny Sachi
then.text: The square’s post is the first. Light it with the Lantern. It’ll wake the old light.

then.name: Granny Sachi
then.text: Now press Q, child, and look at the world through the Lantern. There’s a friend on the other shore; I can feel it.

then.name: Granny Sachi
then.text: A fox, you say? That sounds like Kaze. Go and see Elder Matsu. He’ll want to hear about it.

then.name: Granny Sachi
then.text: The Shrine is north of the square, past the torii. Take your friends. And mind the Bell-Keeper.

then.name: Granny Sachi
then.text: The Well is south-west past the boulder. Don’t push at it; Lantern-bearers go around.

else.name: Granny Sachi
else.text: Daigo’s safe! Bless you. Now: the key, and the Shrine.

br.name: Granny Sachi
br.text: There. Warm tea and a warm blanket. HP, SP, and the Lantern are all topped up.

then.name: Grandfather’s Echo
then.text: Mio. You hold the Lantern the way I did: too tightly. Loosen your grip; light likes room.

then.name: Grandfather’s Echo
then.text: Take this oil. Far Shore light burns fast.

else.name: Grandfather’s Echo
else.text: Posts and rooms like this one hold steady light. Rest when you need to.
Empty now, but it smells of rice.
